responsibilities.name: define the public renderer contract and ECS resource boundary
currentOwners: crates/engine_render/src/renderer.rs::Renderer defines the supported draw, upload, shader, frame, and resize operations
crates/engine_render/src/renderer.rs::RendererRes owns the boxed renderer used by ECS systems

responsibilities.name: prepare CPU-side render assets, geometry, and coordinate transforms
currentOwners: crates/engine_render/src/atlas.rs::AtlasBuilder and upload_atlas_system manage image packing and GPU upload requests
crates/engine_render/src/font.rs::GlyphCache and text layout own embedded-font geometry
crates/engine_render/src/camera.rs and rect.rs own viewport transforms and primitive rectangles
crates/engine_render/src/shape and culling modules own paths, tessellation, and visibility geometry

responsibilities.name: initialize WGPU resources and assemble pipelines
currentOwners: crates/engine_render/src/wgpu_renderer/gpu_init.rs::init_gpu and build_renderer_parts own adapter, device, surface, bind-group, and pipeline construction
crates/engine_render/src/wgpu_renderer/types.rs owns GPU-facing vertex, instance, batch, texture, and material data
crates/engine_render/src/wgpu_renderer/shaders.rs owns embedded quad and shape shader sources
crates/engine_render/src/wgpu_renderer/bloom.rs owns bloom resource layouts, textures, uniforms, and pipelines

responsibilities.name: record frame state and implement the WGPU Renderer contract
currentOwners: crates/engine_render/src/wgpu_renderer/renderer.rs::WgpuRenderer stores upload buffers, persistent meshes, pending material bindings, and frame state
crates/engine_render/src/wgpu_renderer/renderer_trait.rs::Renderer implementation translates public calls into WGPU passes and draw batches
crates/engine_render/src/wgpu_renderer/renderer_trait.rs::frame capture helpers own readback and BMP reporting
dependencies: wgpu command encoders and render passes

responsibilities.name: provide test doubles and headless visual-regression support
currentOwners: crates/engine_render/src/testing/mod.rs::SpyRenderer and capture helpers implement the public Renderer contract for ECS tests
crates/engine_render/src/testing/visual_regression.rs::save_golden, load_golden, and ssim_compare own image evidence utilities
dependencies: Renderer trait and render data types
wgpu fallback adapter and COPY_SRC readback
feature gating through cfg(test) and feature=testing

findings.scope: The default scan covers 56 files with 94 errors and 827 warnings across 48 work units; production contains 32 files with 51 errors and 450 warnings, while tests contain 24 files with 43 errors and 377 warnings. The report and units scan are restricted to crates/engine_render.
findings.architecture: The architecture appendix reports three flat accumulations: 28 types under crates/engine_render/src, 13 under crates/engine_render/src/shape, and 30 under crates/engine_render/src/wgpu_renderer. It reports 70 public-surface findings, one transitive-navigation finding in renderer_trait.rs, zero dependency cycles, zero similarity clusters, zero configurable-data findings, and zero architecture extraction errors.
findings.reason: The public Renderer and RendererRes contract is consumed across engine_app, axiom2d, card_game, engine_ui, demo, and tests; moving or splitting those definitions would widen the API boundary. The WGPU initialization, frame-state, bloom, shader, and renderer-trait owners share tightly coupled resource and pass lifetimes, so extraction would be speculative rather than a behavior-preserving seam. The CPU asset and geometry modules are independently named but feed the same public prelude and WGPU batches. The test harness deliberately mirrors the Renderer contract and the fallback headless renderer has direct adapter evidence, so deduplicating it would erase distinct test responsibilities. Scanner counts therefore do not justify DELETE, DEDUPE, SPLIT, SIMPLIFY, SIGNATURES, or COSMETIC source changes in this child. Source-changing committed replay remains blocked solely by dod-guard#621 because the bundled gate requires the absent .github/quality/quality-baseline.json instead of this repository's docs/QUALITY_BASELINE.ron.
findings.behaviorEvidence: WGPU_BACKEND=vulkan cargo test -p engine_render --test main --locked -- --test-threads=1 --nocapture passed 232 tests, including nine headless visual-regression test functions. A temporary uncommitted adapter probe called HeadlessRenderer::new(1, 1) and passed, proving the forced fallback adapter and render construction execute on this host. No native UI smoke or hosted runner was used.
